items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: All I have to do is wait for Earl Hines to step down, some Sunday, Fats Waller, Jimmy Johnson, Joe Sullivan, and then maybe I'll be next.

ctx.x: Yeah, Ernie Anderson loved him, just like Milt Gabler loved him. So they made a lot of things possible. So here's this jam session. All I have to do is wait for Earl Hines to step down, some Sunday, Fats Waller, Jimmy Johnson, Joe Sullivan, and then maybe I'll be next. And then here comes Joe Bushkin, where did he come from?
But finally, somebody's pushing and I finally get called up to play, the big moment. Just to sit in.
